data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Worst customer support, slow delivery](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/677c0acb738cf949c0ddcf4c)
Hello, I’ve emailed support two times seeking support on and order with no response. I called the toll free number, which directs me back to emailing the same support. I placed my order weeks ago and have had no update. The order has been in “order placed” status since. The slowness of shipping, unresponsive customer service, and inability to make contact has made this the worst customer service (lackthereof) I’ve ever had from a home furnishing e-commerce company. Especially given I spent over $400 on my first order with you.

January 6, 2025

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jan 6, 2025

Hi Adam,

Your recent inquiry has been addressed by our support team, and an update regarding your order has been provided. We deeply regret any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding. Should you require further information or support, please feel free to contact us. It is our pleasure to assist you.

Wishing you an excellent remainder of the week!
